notes: Official Boavision docs use bare numeric paths: /11 = main (H.264), /12 = sub (H.264), both on port 554. Authentication credentials are embedded in the URL (rtsp://user:pass@ip:554/11). ONVIF port is 8080. No channel index in the path — these are fixed single-channel paths. Confirmed from the HD22M102M user manual (pages 23 and 30), which is the only official Boavision manual publicly available. All 12 strix leads were cross-brand noise — none matched the documented paths.
